reason: Linux: an ignored SIGCHLD disposition is itself the no-zombie state (a wait fails with ECHILD once the children are gone) and execve preserves SIG_IGN while clearing action flags (flush_signal_handlers, v6.18), so skipping the worker repair loses the worker's wait. The Darwin premise (skip-repair is already waitable because exec clears the flag) does not exist on this kernel; this row is a failing discriminator of its own, and the E04 worker row stays independent.
